states.caption: Moving the focus down the list (loops).

a.name: Card
a.note: A centred card over the dimmed level. Familiar, but it hides the middle of the screen.

b.name: Sidebar
b.note: A full-height column on the left; the level stays visible on the right, so you can see what you paused on.

c.name: Minimal
c.note: Just the list over a darker dim, no panel. Cleanest, weakest focus.

recommend.why: Players pause to check the situation: the sidebar keeps the level in view, and the focus bar reads well on a pad.
